propositions: Current _optionality.yml fans out 6 matrix cells (5 per-extra + 1 union) causing 21 concurrent job slots, exceeding GitHub Free org limit of 20 and blocking macOS jobs (5 concurrent limit shared org-wide)

The 5 per-extra matrix cells plus union cell can be collapsed into a single job with a venv loop running 7 iterations (one per key in _optional.EXTRAS union {mcp}, plus one union iteration) to reduce peak slot usage

The venv loop must use absolute paths ("$v/bin/python", "$v/bin/rebar-mcp"), never source activate, accumulate errors via rc variable with continue/exit $rc, and never stack venv activations across iterations
The loop must cover metrics (currently missing per-extra CI despite being in _optional.EXTRAS) and validate mcp via rebar-mcp --help only in its dedicated iteration
main-protection.snapshot.json hard-codes obsolete check names and is POSTed back by rollback-mirror-lock.sh, so stale entries would freeze main during emergency rollbacks
Durable checked-in tests must assert the loop contains rc accumulator shape with continue/exit $rc and no activate, and verify every _optional.EXTRAS key appears in the looped list
